extracted.intended_audience: Small business applicants preparing an NIH SBIR (PA-16-302) grant application / NIH NIAID sample-application users
extracted.subtask_description: A Phase I SBIR (PA-16-302) sample NIH grant application showing required forms, research plan sections, biosketches, facilities/equipment descriptions, budgets, personnel justification, leadership plan, and supporting documentation needed to prepare and submit an NIH SBIR application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow FOA application format
rubrics_metrics.description: Always follow your funding opportunity's instructions for application format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although this application demonstrates good grantsmanship, time has passed since the grantee applied. The samples may not reflect the latest format or rules. NIAID posts new samples periodically: https://www.niaid.nih.gov/grants-contracts/sample-applications

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete SF424 (R&R) required fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete all SF424 (R&R) cover-page and applicant-identification fields (type of submission, applicant DUNS, legal name, type of applicant, EIN/TIN, authorized representative details, contact PD/PI information, project start/end dates, Congressional district, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields shown include Type of Submission, Applicant Information, PD/PI contact, Organizational DUNS, EIN/TIN, Type of Applicant, whether the application is being submitted to other agencies, and Authorized Representative signature and date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorized representative certification and assurances
rubrics_metrics.description: By signing the application, the authorized representative certifies the statements contained in the list of certifications and provides required assurances, agreeing to comply with terms if an award is accepted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signature certifies that statements are true and that false statements may subject the signer to penalties (U.S. Code, Title 18, Section 1001). The list of certifications and assurances or an Internet site where they may be obtained is contained in the announcement or agency-specific instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary/Abstract requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Project Summary/Abstract that concisely explains the project's significance, objectives, approach, and intended outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Project Summary/Abstract in this sample explains significance of antibody:antigen characterization, approach integrating Wasatch SPR with computational methods, and intended application to HSV; used to communicate the core idea succinctly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Narrative (public-health relevance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Project Narrative that states the public-health relevance and overall impact of the proposed research in plain language.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample Project Narrative emphasizes how detailed characterization of antibody:antigen binding is fundamental to understanding/improving biotherapeutics and vaccines and how the proposed high-throughput integration will drive discovery and development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Plan components: Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.description: Include Specific Aims as a distinct section outlining the concrete, testable objectives of the proposed research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific Aims appear in the Table of Contents and are expected to be a short, focused section (see project organization in the sample).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Plan components: Research Strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Research Strategy that includes background, significance, preliminary data, detailed approach, expected outcomes, and discussion of pitfalls and alternatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample's Research Strategy describes experimental/computational aims, study selection, validation plans (e.g., X-Ray crystallography), and a 'Pitfalls and Alternatives' subsection; includes Phase II look-ahead when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple PD/PI leadership plan
rubrics_metrics.description: When multiple PIs are proposed, submit a Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan describing roles, responsibilities, management structure, communication, and conflict-resolution mechanisms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample plan: lists each PI's responsibilities, meeting cadence (monthly group meetings, weekly subgroup meetings), reporting responsibility, and a rule to defer to the PI with the most expertise in a particular area for disagreements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources description
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe institutional and company facilities and resources available to complete the proposed work, including laboratory space, office space, machine shop, cleanroom access, and library resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Samples include square footage, lab benches, fume hoods, equipment lists, machine shop access, embedded employees in partner labs, and proximity/access to university libraries and core facilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment availability and details
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide an Equipment section listing key instruments and specialized equipment available to the project (both onsite and via collaborators), including model names where relevant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample enumerates centrifuges, biosafety cabinet, incubators, CFMs, IBIS MX96 SPR imagers, BiaCore instruments, MicroCal ITC200, ultracentrifuges, FPLC, confocal microscope, EM, FACS, printing/microfabrication tools, and computational clusters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Other Project Information: human subjects declaration
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether human subjects are involved and if so whether the project is exempt, IRB review pending, and provide IRB approval dates or exemption numbers as required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form fields ask: Are Human Subjects Involved? If YES, Is the Project Exempt? If NO, Is the IRB review pending? IRB Approval Date and Human Subject Assurance Number are requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Other Project Information: vertebrate animals declaration
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether vertebrate animals are used and provide IACUC approval status and Animal Welfare Assurance numbers as required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form fields ask: Are Vertebrate Animals Used? If YES, Is the IACUC review pending? IACUC Approval Date and Animal Welfare Assurance Number are requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Other Project Information: proprietary/privileged information flag
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether proprietary or privileged information is included in the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form field: Is proprietary/privileged information included in the application? Yes/No.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Other Project Information: environmental impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether the project has an actual or potential impact on the environment and, if so, whether an environmental assessment or environmental impact statement has been performed or exemption authorized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form fields: Does this project have an actual or potential impact on the environment? If yes, explain and note whether an EA or EIS has been performed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Other Project Information: international activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether the project involves activities outside the United States or partnerships with international collaborators and identify countries if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form prompts for identification of countries and optional explanation if activities occur outside the U.S.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Performance Site information
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide project/performance site locations including organization name, DUNS, address, and Congressional district for each site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample lists Wasatch Microfluidics (primary), Dartmouth College, and Trustees of the University of Pennsylvania with project performance site congressional districts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person profiles and biosketches
rubrics_metrics.description: Include Research & Related Senior/Key Person profiles and attach biosketch files and Current & Pending Support documentation for each senior/key person.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Profiles include Project Role, Organization, and attachments like Biosketch and Current & Pending Support files (file names shown in sample).

rubrics_metrics.name: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH format and length limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the NIH biographical sketch format and do not exceed five pages for each biosketch; include sections such as Personal Statement, Positions and Honors, Contribution to Science, and Research Support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample Biosketch header: 'BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH Provide the following information... DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.' Sample includes sections A–D (Personal Statement; Positions and Honors; Contribution to Science; Research Support).

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel justification and effort allocation
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Personnel Justification that specifies personnel roles, responsibilities, and percent effort (or months) for each key person and staffing plan for students/technicians.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample entries: 'Prof. Chris Bailey-Kellogg (.25 Summer Months) will oversee computational components' and 'Dartmouth PhD student (TBD, 9 Calendar Months) will lead the research effort...'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget and Budget Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Research & Related Budget forms for each year, cumulative budget, consortium/subaward budgets, and a Budget Justification explaining costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table of Contents shows 'Research & Related Budget Year - 1', 'Budget Justification', 'Cumulative Budget', and separate 'Consortium Budget (Subaward 1/2)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium/subaward documentation and budgets
rubrics_metrics.description: When subcontractors or consortium partners are involved, include separate consortium/subaward budgets and describe subcontractor roles and contributions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample includes 'Research & Related Budget - Consortium Budget (Subaward 1)' and 'Subaward collocated at UPenn to facilitate communication and workflow' described in leadership plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support / non-binding collaboration letters
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide letters of support from collaborators or industry partners indicating the nature and extent of their support; letters are typically non-binding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample includes letters from collaborators (Pfizer, Pasteur Institute, Botswana-UPenn Partnership) that describe collaborative access to samples, facilities, or future interest, and explicitly note non-binding nature where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: References Cited / Bibliography
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a Bibliography & References Cited section listing relevant literature supporting the proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table of Contents and sample include 'Bibliography & References Cited' with numbered references relevant to methods and prior work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior and Current Support and Patent disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose prior SBIR/STTR awards, current and pending support, and relevant patents or intellectual property.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample biosketch and Research Support sections list ongoing and completed grants, Phase I/II awards, and patent information (title, inventors, application numbers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Section 508 conformance and accessibility note
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure documents conform to Section 508 accessibility standards and provide contact information for accessibility help.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: the sample has been reformatted to improve accessibility and provides an email contact (deaweb@niaid.nih.gov) for assistance if users have trouble accessing content.

rubrics_metrics.name: FOIA and confidentiality expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Acknowledge that when NIH responds to FOIA requests, materials may be subject to FOIA exemptions and include substantial redactions to protect confidential commercial/financial information, reviewer comments, and personal privacy information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample makes explicit statement about FOIA redactions and NIH's commitment to protecting peer review integrity and confidentiality.

rubrics_metrics.name: OMB and form expiration compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Be aware of OMB control numbers and form expiration dates referenced on forms and ensure use of current valid forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample pages display 'OMB Number' and 'Expiration Date' headers on form pages; the text notes that the sample may be outdated and to follow the current FOA instructions.
